retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochromatic red duotone featuring a side-profile portrait with bold, outlined script typography in the upper corner.
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif typography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A striking visual composition dominated by a saturated red field, featuring a high-contrast black-and-red profile of a man on the right side, balanced by a stylized, outlined script logo in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic red palette unifying subject and background
Right-aligned profile portrait facing left into negative space
Upper-left typographic anchor balancing the subject's weight
High-contrast shadows creating depth within a flat color field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the right third and bottom corner of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and nose profile on the right; the script logo on the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the high-contrast logo, follows the arc of the typography, and settles on the detailed profile of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive flat red negative space in the center and left-middle areas.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with extreme value contrast between deep blacks and bright red.
paletteRestrictions: White used only for graphic accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a heavy slant
letterConstructionRules: Double-outline effect (black core with white exterior stroke)
characterSpecificRedesigns: A thin white arc or 'swoosh' extends from the final letter back over the text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used as a brand mark against a photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, heavy brush stroke feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast side-profile portrait of a man with long hair, rendered in a monochromatic red duotone where shadows are black and highlights are saturated red. Position the face on the right edge of the frame facing left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom black script logo with a thick white outline in the top-left corner. Add a thin white arc that starts above the last letter and curves back toward the beginning of the word.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic red and black?
Is the portrait a side profile on the right side?
Does the text have a black fill with a white outline?
Is there a white arc graphic above the text?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person

avoid: Low-resolution pixelation in the red field

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red is vibrant and not orange or pink.
Check that the white outline is consistent around all letters.
Verify the profile is clearly defined against the red background.
Confirm the text is legible despite the heavy styling.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic [Color] + High-Contrast Profile [Subject] + Outlined Script [Typography Position]
